name: gns3-lab
description: Build, wire, configure and troubleshoot GNS3 network labs: projects, nodes (RAM, CPUs, QEMU disks, CD-ROM, options), links, device consoles, SSH, drawings and topology export. Bundles the gns3-mcp server (runs locally with uvx) and a skill with the workflows.

gns3_host.title: GNS3 server host
gns3_host.description: Hostname or IP of the GNS3 server. Leave empty to use GNS3_HOST from the environment or ~/.gns3-mcp/.env (default localhost).

gns3_port.title: GNS3 server port
gns3_port.description: GNS3 API port. Leave empty for GNS3_PORT from the environment or ~/.gns3-mcp/.env (default 80).

gns3_user.title: GNS3 username
gns3_user.description: Leave empty for GNS3_USER from the environment or ~/.gns3-mcp/.env (default admin).

gns3_password.title: GNS3 password
gns3_password.description: Stored in the system credential store. Leave empty to use GNS3_PASSWORD from the environment or ~/.gns3-mcp/.env.
